summary: EduPostEmployment is a user control for managing staff education records post-employment within the HSPnet system. It handles displaying, adding, editing, deleting, and validating education items for staff, with support for different education fields, delivery methods, graduation confirmation, and term/year selection. The system is tightly integrated with ASP.NET controls and utilizes modal popups, form views, grid views, and object data sources for its operations.
purpose: To facilitate the management, insertion, update, and deletion of staff education records post-employment, ensuring accurate data entry, business rule enforcement, and proper UI feedback.

workflows.name: Add Staff Education Entry
steps: User initiates add via cmdAdd or empty data button.
Grid switches to add mode and shows details modal.
FormView validates input with dropdowns for Program, Delivery Method, Term, Term Year, Graduation Confirmed.
On insert, values are extracted from form controls and cast appropriately.
If input is valid, entry is inserted to StaffPostEducation.
Session cached, UI redirected to current page.

workflows.name: Edit Staff Education Entry
steps: User initiates edit via cmdEdit.
Grid switches to edit mode and shows details modal.
FormView pre-populates dropdowns with existing values.
Changes are made and validated.
On update, values are extracted and cast.
If input is valid, entry is updated.
Session cached, UI redirected to current page.

workflows.name: Delete Staff Education Entry
steps: User triggers delete via cmdDelete.
System calls StaffPostEducations.StaffPostEducationDelete with session and EducationID.
Session cached, UI redirected to current page.

workflows.name: Validate and Select Data
steps: Data source (ObjectDataSource) events supply UserSession and StaffID parameters.
On selection, checks for valid session; cancels if not present.

workflows.name: UI Rendering
steps: GridView binds rows, configures edit, delete, add buttons based on ScreenIsEditable.
FormView manages modal display, dropdown pre-selection, calendar, and waitlist action.
JavaScript variables and startup scripts set up for async postbacks and client display.

business_rules: Entry cannot be inserted or updated if the page is not valid.
GraduationConfirmed is set based on dropdown selection (0 or 1).
Dropdowns for Program, DeliveryMethod, Term, TermYear must have valid selections (converted to int, with default 0 if no selection).
Session must be present for data operations; else, operation cancels.
validations: Page.IsValid must be true for insert/update.
Dropdown values must be convertible to integer; if not, default to 0.
Session presence is validated on selecting and updating operations.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable governs visibility and availability of controls.
If no rows and editable, show add button.
If UserSession is null, cancel data operations.
GraduationConfirmed dropdown changes text and value based on boolean.
system_behavior: Grid switches between add, edit, and view modes.
Modal popup shown for details entry/editing.
Controls are dynamically enabled/disabled based on ScreenIsEditable.
Page is redirected after insert, update, or delete.
dependencies: JavaScript and ScriptManager for client interactivity
exceptions: Operation cancelled if session is invalid.
content_gaps: Underlying database schema for StaffPostEducation not fully specified.
Business rules for ProgramID, DeliveryMethodCodeID, TermCodeID, TermYear validation beyond dropdown conversion not specified.
Details regarding waitlist actions, costs, and additional user permissions are referenced but not described.
